stories.title: ‘On notice’: what the new First Minister said about Betsi Cadwaladr this week
stories.summary: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board has marked 11 years in special measures with Wales’s new First Minister putting the board formally “on notice.” Rhun ap Iorwerth made the comments during questions in the Senedd on Monday as opposition members pressed him on what the new Plaid Cymru government would do differently on north Wales health

stories.title: Governors defend under-threat school amid fresh calls to pause Flintshire super-school plan
stories.summary: A fresh call has been made to halt the relaunch of Flintshire’s controversial Catholic super-school plans after governors at one school slated for closure insisted it remained viable. Last month the Chair of Governors at St Anthony’s Catholic Primary School in Saltney issued a letter stating that the Governing Body supports keeping the school open

stories.title: Flintshire bus passengers to be asked for views on future network ahead of 2028 franchising
stories.summary: Flintshire bus passengers are being asked to have their say on the county’s future bus network, after councillors backed plans to take a draft route map to public consultation this summer. Flintshire County Council’s scrutiny committee gave its support on Tuesday to a base network of 34 bus routes, which Transport for Wales will use

stories.title: Family appeals for return of ‘memory bear’ after car stolen in Shotton overnight
stories.summary: A family is appealing for help to find a memory bear sewn from a late grandfather’s shirts, after it was taken along with a car stolen from a Shotton street in the early hours of Monday morning. North Wales Police confirmed two vehicles were stolen and a third damaged in the Shotton and Queensferry area

stories.title: Flint RNLI volunteer named Flintshire Young Volunteer of the Year
stories.summary: A Flint RNLI volunteer has been named Flintshire Young Volunteer of the Year at an awards ceremony held during National Volunteer Week. Erin Brown received the award at the Flintshire Local Volunteer Council Volunteer Awards on Friday, 5 June.
